'''Radiation lights''' were a type of lightsource which could be used to grow [[plant]]s in indoor environments. The [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] trader [[Morga Bunna]] used radiation lights to grow plants from his [[homeworld]] in his [[Morga Bunna's supply depot|supply depot]] on the [[planet]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph's]] [[Bosph's outermost moon|outermost moon]].<ref name="Scourge" />

==Behind the scenes==
Radiation lights first appeared in the novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], which was written by [[Jeff Grubb]] and released in [[2012]].
